item.title: How to translate text with Angular i18n
item.description: Implementing internationalization is crucial for Angular applications that serve users in multiple languages and regions. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built multilingual interfaces for global enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to use Angular’s built-in i18n system with the i18n attribute to mark translatable text. This approach integrates seamlessly with Angular’s build process and provides compile-time translation for optimal performance.
